results.note: endpoint_is_on_prem collapses three-valued None to False for an unparseable URL, so a spec with on_prem unset and no hostname is reported as off-prem rather than unknown
capabilities: an explicit on_prem=False is overridden by the endpoint heuristic, so a localhost endpoint declared off-prem still advertises ON_PREM
_target: when the server reports an empty loaded list, a named model is no longer refused as not-loaded and falls through to be requested (which would load it from disk)
probe: a context of exactly ROOMY_CONTEXT (65536) tokens now triggers the oversized-window warning; boundary off-by-one
invoke: a whitespace-only completion is returned as 'answered' instead of the empty-content failure (and would then be cached)
_locate stdout-json: a chatty CLI's envelope is looked for on the first line instead of the last, so banner text before the JSON makes the answer unlocatable
_argv: an empty placeholder no longer removes its preceding flag, so e.g. '--schema' is passed with no value when req.schema is None
probe: an upper-case .CMD/.BAT shim (common on Windows) skips the --version validation and is reported ready even when it points at a deleted binary
invoke: the prompt is fed on stdin exactly when it was already written to {prompt_file}, and withheld from stdin when it was not, so a stdin-driven CLI gets no prompt
_argv: with no schema requested a schema.json containing 'null' is still written and the {schema_file} flag is kept rather than dropped
run: a failed response is written to the cache (a cache file appears after a failure), breaking 'written only on answered'
_read: a cache entry whose text is empty is served as a hit, returning an 'answered' Response with no text instead of re-asking the backend
